messages:
kevin (acct-mgmt): Hey team — customer reported an external scan flagged a transitive vuln in `lib-xyz` used by our image-builder. They want SBOM + ETA for remediation and whether KMS rotations are needed. can we provide an evidence window by EOD?

maria (sec-eng): Which CVE/scan did they share? link?

kevin (acct-mgmt): They attached a screenshot referencing CVE-2026-2104 from their pentest vendor. no exploit seen in their env, but they asked specifically for SOC2 evidence and a patch timeline.

ops-bot: Automated alert: dependency-scan: project=image-builder, vuln=CVE-2026-2104, severity=HIGH, introduced-by=transitive(`lib-xyz@1.2.3`).

maria (sec-eng): ok. quick triage: CVE-2026-2104 affects deserialization in `lib-xyz` <1.2.5. upstream released 1.2.5 with fix and patch notes. No known public exploit in the wild yet. Recommend patching as high priority for customer-facing workloads.

jenny (sre): image-builder runs in CI and produces base images for hosted and dedicated. Which images did scan hit? kevin, do they want evidence for all tenants or just the one customer?

kevin (acct-mgmt): just that customer's tenant for now, they want SBOM + confirmation we won't be putting secrets at risk (they asked about KMS rotation).

maria (sec-eng): For KMS rotation: if vulnerability is only in build-time dependency and does not run in production with access to keys, rotation likely not required. But we should confirm whether any build artifacts containing credentials are stored in artifacts bucket unencrypted or accidentally baked in.

devin (platform): quick check: our build dockerfiles do not copy any runtime env vars; KMS keys are only referenced at deploy time by the private deployer service. I don't see direct exposure but will run a scan on build artifacts.

maria (sec-eng): Action items: 1) produce SBOM for the specific image the customer referenced and upload to secure bucket; 2) patch `lib-xyz` in the builder pipeline and cut a canary image; 3) confirm no secret material in build artifacts and advise on KMS rotation only if we find exposure; 4) provide SOC2-style evidence (signed note + artifact hashes). ETA proposals below.

kevin (acct-mgmt): that sounds good — can you give an ETA I can pass to customer? they asked for remediation window and whether we can do a temporary mitigation if patching takes longer.

maria (sec-eng): ETA: SBOM export + evidence note in 3 hrs. Patch in CI and canary image within 8 hrs (non-business-hours if we need to schedule), full rollout after 24h monitoring. Temporary mitigation: add runtime dependency denial via container policy (Distroless / OPA policy) to prevent `lib-xyz` being loaded, or runtime patching is harder. We can also block builds from that specific pipeline until fixed.

devin (platform): I can generate the SBOM and push to s3://redwood-evidence/customer-uploads/kevin-1864123460/ — command I run: ```sh
# generate sbom for image used in build
docker run --rm -v /var/lib/docker:/var/lib/docker anchore/syft:latest syft registry:myregistry/redwood/image-builder:20260318 -o json > sbom-image-builder-20260318.json
```
I'll also upload and set ACL to restricted.

jenny (sre): For canary: I'll pin one dedicated pool to the new image and monitor CPU/memory and auth errors for 24h. If anything suspicious, rollback.

maria (sec-eng): For SOC2 evidence, we need: - SBOM file with manifest and hashes - short signed statement (sec-eng) describing impact & mitigations - timeline of actions (ticket IDs and deployment IDs) - confirmation of KMS review (devin)

kevin (acct-mgmt): customer asked whether we will rotate their tenant keys proactively. They're OK with guidance but prefer we do it if exposure confirmed.

devin (platform): If we confirm artifacts don't contain secrets, no forced rotation. If we detect secret material in images or build caches, we should rotate and I can script rotation via our KMS API: `./scripts/rotate-tenant-key --tenant $TENANT_ID --rotate-now`. Rotation run takes ~15m with key rewrap steps.

maria (sec-eng): I'll prepare the short signed note and the risk statement. kevin, can you ask customer to share exact image digest they scanned (sha256:...). that will help us generate matching SBOM and confirm the finding.

kevin (acct-mgmt): pinged customer for digest, they replied with `sha256:8a7f...b2c1`. added to ticket.

devin (platform): grabbed the image from registry and started syft run. uploading SBOM now. link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-evidence/customer-uploads/kevin-1864123460/sbom-image-builder-20260318.json (restricted).

maria (sec-eng): reviewing SBOM — confirms `lib-xyz@1.2.3` present in the image. I'll draft the SOC2-style note now.

ops-bot: Ticket created: SEC-4821 - CVE-2026-2104 triage & remediation (owner=maria, priority=high).

maria (sec-eng): Drafted evidence note: "We have identified CVE-2026-2104 impacting lib-xyz@1.2.3 in the referenced image. Mitigation: upgrade to lib-xyz@1.2.5 in build pipeline; canary image deployed to dedicated pool; monitoring for 24h. No evidence of secret material in build artifacts per initial scan. KMS rotation not required at this time."

kevin (acct-mgmt): customer accepted the note and asked for the remediation/timeline to be added to SOC2 artifact bundle. they want the canary image digest once available.

jenny (sre): canary is live: new image digest `sha256:1f2e...c9d8` deployed to pool-qa-1. will monitor and post updates in this thread.

maria (sec-eng): After 4h of monitoring no anomalous auth events. I'll sign the evidence bundle and attach SBOM + ticket export.

kevin (acct-mgmt): passing to customer — they requested a short walkthrough doc on why KMS rotation wasn't done. can we add 2-3 bullets?

maria (sec-eng): Added bullets: 1) vuln is in build-time transitive dependency not present in runtime processes that access KMS; 2) build artifacts scanned — no secrets detected; 3) patch applied at build pipeline and rolled via controlled canary; 4) we will revisit if any change in evidence.

devin (platform): note: if customer still requests rotation, I can run scripted rotation and provide rotation job ID + rewrap log. takes ~15m and will cause brief deploys.

kevin (acct-mgmt): customer happy with the explanation and timeline. asked for final artifact bundle (SBOM + signed note + ticket link).

maria (sec-eng): uploaded signed bundle to s3 and linked ticket SEC-4821. finishing thread notes.

jenny (sre): closing monitoring watch — no regressions.

kevin (acct-mgmt): thanks all — sending final bundle to customer now. :thumbsup:

maria (sec-eng): thanks team. follow-up: add `lib-xyz` to our dependency watchlist and set auto-alert for new CVEs.

devin (platform): added to dependabot-style list.

kevin (acct-mgmt): noted, closing from customer side.
